facts.still-horse: The knight sits on a black horse standing still on all four legs.
facts.pentacle-hand: He holds a pentacle on the palm of one hand.
facts.oak-sprigs: Green leaf ornaments are fixed to the helmet and to the horse's head.
facts.plowed-field: Behind, plowed furrows of a field spread out.
facts.yellow-sky: The sky is yellow, and trees can be seen far off on the right.
facts.armor: Over the armor he wears a surcoat with red stripes.

glosses.plowed-field: Land plowed steadily; preparation that took time.
glosses.pentacle-hand: An attitude of holding responsibility in hand and not hurrying.

reversedGloss.excess: Caution goes too far, and he stops in place.
reversedGloss.waning: The steady strength is broken by boredom.
